name: Cheng Uei Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Cheng Uei Precision Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cable assemblies, battery packs, and power modules in Taiwan, China, America, Vietnam, India, Hong Kong, and internationally. It operates through System and Peripheral Products, 3C Product Retail, Energy Service Management, and Other segments. The company offers pogo pins, type C receptacles, type C plugs, HDMI and automotive connectors, audio jacks, and MIM components; single-side, double-side, multi-flex, rigid-flex, and automotive FPCs; active electrical and optical cables, transceivers, MCIO and PCIe riser cables, USB and thunderbolt cables, lightning and HDMI cables, and dongles; USB, face authentication, compact, and 3D came…
